title: Core: LogStorage trait, in-memory implementation, SQLite implementation
description: Define a LogStorage trait in usenet-ipfs-core that abstracts persistence of group log entries. Provide an in-memory implementation for tests and an SQLite implementation for production. All group log operations (append, query, backfill) use the trait — no direct SQLite calls in business logic. Migrations managed by sqlx. This is the persistence foundation for the Merkle-CRDT group log.
